=You are an expert AI Search & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) Data Strategist.
Based on the provided Brand Identity JSON, generate a comprehensive matrix of {{ $json.total_seeds }} distinct intent-driven seeds.

Instructions:
Distribute the {{ $json.total_seeds }} seeds balanced across the 4 GEO Lifecycle Stages:
DISCOVERY ({{ $json.discovery_dist }}): Unaware of brand; focus on general needs, local activities, or broad queries.
COMPARISON ({{ $json.comparison_dist }}): Evaluating alternatives, comparing tools, or weighing options.
BRAND TRUST ({{ $json.brandtrust_dist }}): Evaluating security, web speed, privacy, or validity.
DROPOUT_CHURN ({{ $json.dropout_dist }}): Frustrated by limitations, looking for alternatives.

Each seed MUST contain tight logical cohesion between primary_intent, key_pain_point, and perceived_barrier.

Return ONLY a valid JSON array of seed objects using the provided schema.
[
  {
    "seed_id": "SEED_01",
    "lifecycle_stage": "DISCOVERY", "COMPARISON", "BRAND TRUST" or "DROPOUT_CHURN"
    "primary_intent": "Find a concise 2-hour gallery walking route in Beyoğlu without manual planning.",
    "key_pain_points": [
      "Overwhelmed by generic pins on Google Maps",
      "Doesn't want to install an app for a short visit",
      "Short on time between afternoon coffee and dinner"
    ],
    "contextual_barrier": "Skeptical that web apps work smoothly on spotty mobile data."
  }
]

BRAND ENTITY INPUT: {{ $json.brand_identity }}

=You are an AI Buyer Persona Strategist.

You will receive the Brand Identity JSON and an array of {{ $json.total_seeds }} Matrix Seeds.
Transform each seed into a fully fleshed-out Persona object.

Instructions:
-Preserve the exact primary_intent, key_pain_points, and lifecycle_stage provided in the seed.
-Add realistic demographics, language preferences, location contexts, and technical profiles that logically fit the seed's intent.

-Return ONLY a valid JSON array matching the Persona output schema.

the 4 GEO Lifecycle Stages:
DISCOVERY: Unaware of brand; focus on general needs, local activities, or broad queries.
COMPARISON : Evaluating alternatives, comparing tools, or weighing options.
BRAND TRUST : Evaluating security, web speed, privacy, or validity.
DROPOUT_CHURN: Frustrated by limitations, looking for alternatives.

=You are an expert Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) Analyst and Search Intent Strategist.

YOUR TASK:
Take the provided array of 10 structured Personas and generate 50 realistic, natural-language prompts (5 distinct prompts per persona) in TURKISH. These prompts will be sent to AI models (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to audit brand visibility for "Freya Art / Beyoğlu Sanat Rotası".

---

### GENERATION RULES:

1. LANGUAGE & NATURALNESS:
- Write all prompts in authentic, natural Turkish as written by real users.
- Vary the prompt lengths across the 5 prompts per persona: include short search-style queries, medium conversational questions, and longer multi-sentence contextual prompts.
- Include natural phrasing, occasional missing turkish diacritics (mobile typing style), or everyday conversational tone.

2. LIFECYCLE STAGE STICKINESS:
- DISCOVERY: Absolutely NO mention of "Freya" or "Freya Art". Focus purely on location (Beyoğlu, Taksim, Galata), needs (2-hour walk, student budget, free exhibitions), and general solutions.
- COMPARISON: Focus on comparing generic options or existing apps (Google Maps, Kültür.istanbul, ArtDog) against specialized web-based route planners.
- BRAND TRUST: Explicitly mention the brand ("Freya Art Sanat Rotası", "FreyaArt seergi rehberi", "Freya Beyoğlu Sanat Rotası" and alternatives) and even somtimes the website (https://www.freyartt.com/beyoglu-sergi-rehberi/ or https://www.freyartt.com/) and ask about credibility, pricing, live venue accuracy, or sign-up requirements.
- DROPOUT / CHURN: Mention the brand and express specific limitations (e.g., "only Beyoğlu", "requires 2 venues") while asking for alternatives or broader city coverage.

3. CONTEXT INTEGRATION:
- Indirectly reflect the persona's key pain points and location context (e.g., P03 mentioning student discount/free entry; P05 specifying "app indirmeden / web sitesi üzerinden").

---

### OUTPUT FORMAT REQUIREMENTS:

Return ONLY a valid JSON array of 50 prompt objects. Do NOT wrap in introductory or concluding text.

[
  {
    "prompt_id": "P001PR001",
    "persona_id": "P-001",
    "lifecycle_stage": "DISCOVERY",
    "prompt_type": "Short / Conversational / Complex",
    "prompt_text": "The exact Turkish text to send to the AI model",
  }
]
Brand Identity: {{ $('Edit Fields').first().json.brand_identity }}

Personas: {{ JSON.stringify($json.seeds) }}
